summary: Keep Web model selection authority strictly session-scoped: only explicit human model_change (or new-session creation) may mutate a session's model_override; stale browser snapshots can no longer create authority on a session that had none; the session list exposes the effective model read-only so the WebUI restores each session's own model on switch instead of conflating per-run model_used telemetry with authority.

components.owning_subsystem: session-scoped model routing authority (existing Session.model_override via M48 routing pool) and Web ingress intent handling
components.disposition: ADMIT as a narrowing of control: authority mutation now requires explicit human intent (model_change or new_session). Known model refs route through accepted Session authority; unknown refs keep per-call routing for the honest unavailable fact. New sessions inherit the previous shared session's override (M60, aligned with feishu M52-fix / CLI /new). No new store or authority layer is introduced.
evidence: SessionMeta now carries model_override as a read-only passthrough (list/cache rebuild sites covered); the runtime Session persistence of model_override predates this change (M48/M52) and is untouched.
tests/web regression: a session with no override stays untouched when a request arrives without explicit model_change.
tests/web regression: stale web model snapshot cannot overwrite an in-run switch_model authority change.
New-session inheritance reads the old shared session's override fail-open (missing/corrupt old session does not block session creation).
components.verification_level: tests/web full run plus model_override-adjacent unit files, Ruff, Pyright, WebUI vitest suite, WebUI production build, worktree-clean candidate
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: In-run switch_model remains authoritative and can still move a session's model at any time; sending requests without model_change never mutates authority; operators can revert the single implementation commit with no data migration (old sessions read the new meta key as None).
components.rollback_route: Revert d877e208c together with this manifest; no runtime.toml, credential, or persisted-data migration is required.

No runtime authority lives in the client.

Session switching restores model from SessionMeta.model; list polling does not override a pending explicit selection.

g1.necessity: Web model selection previously conflated UI continuity with authority: payload.model was sent on every request, so a stale browser snapshot could create or mutate a session's model authority without explicit human intent, and one session's selection leaked into another session's effective routing.

g2.authority_owner: the existing per-Session model_override authority resolved by the M48 model routing pool
g2.non_duplication: No new configuration store or routing authority is added. The change extends SessionMeta with a read-only passthrough of the existing override, adds one explicit-intent request field, and removes the client-side writeback that duplicated authority into the selector.

model_evidence: session list API exposes each session's effective model (override or assembly default) as a read-only fact
regressions proving stale snapshots cannot create or overwrite authority and that explicit change can replace it
new-session inheritance is fail-open and mirrors feishu M52-fix / CLI /new semantics
g3.recovery_or_reason: In-run switch_model remains a model-invokable authority change at any time; requests without model_change are pure no-ops on authority; omitting the field entirely preserves pre-existing session authority; old persisted sessions read the new meta key as None.

g4.rollback: Revert the single implementation commit d877e208c plus this manifest; no persisted-data migration, runtime.toml change, or credential change is involved.
